topics.topic: Whether rules.http_router_backend now contains 50 routes or still contains 56 with six challenge routes filtered elsewhere
questions: Does the current rules.http_router_backend contain 50 routes after removing the six challenge routes, or does it still contain 56?
Does the current `rules.http_router_backend` contain 50 routes with the six staff-challenge routes removed, or does it still contain 56 routes?
Was `rules.http_router_backend` itself revised to a 50-route catalog, or must the API filter six challenge routes from the still-56-route backend?

quotes:
- **Route table** is `rules.http_router_backend` (56 routes, 49 table and 7
  irregular, in the accepted spec; 50 and 43 since the six challenge routes
  left on 2026-11-07, R0-23) instead of the former `rules.http_route_catalog`; administrator
  project discovery `GET /admin/projects` is added (R0-08).
judgement.why: State 5 explicitly says the current backend has 50 routes, 43 table routes and 7 irregular routes, after the six challenge routes left.

topics.topic: Whether the M01–M37 model set includes or excludes M08–M12
questions: Is M01–M37 meant as an inclusive set that still contains M08–M12, or as a numbered range with those five models absent?

quotes:
*Withdrawn by the owner on 2026-11-07 (R0-03, R0-23):* the portal has no
>    email challenge, no email delivery and no notification, and sends no
>    email; an administrator activates a new account and the holder changes
>    the initial password. The former models M08–M12 (`PasswordResetToken`,
>    `EmailVerificationChallenge`, `PendingEmailChange`,
>    `EmailDeliveryRecord`, `EmailDeliveryRequest`) are removed.
judgement.why: The explicit removal controls; M01–M37 describes the identifier span of the remaining State 1 records and does not require filling its intentional numbering gap.
